args.description:
Fix the astropy ascii.qdp reader (/testbed/astropy/io/ascii/qdp.py) to be case-insensitive, matching QDP's own behavior. Required changes, all in /testbed/astropy/io/ascii/qdp.py only (do NOT touch tests or config files):

1. In the `_line_type` function, compile `_line_type_re` with `re.IGNORECASE` (i.e. `re.compile(_type_re, re.IGNORECASE)`) so commands like "read serr 1 2" or "Read TERR 1" are recognized, and so the existing doctest examples still pass.

2. In the data-parsing loop in `_read_table_qdp` (the `for v in line.split(delimiter):` loop inside the `if datatype.startswith("data"):` branch), change the masked-value check from `if v == "NO":` to a case-insensitive comparison (e.g. `if v.upper() == "NO":`) so that a lowercase "no" in a data line is treated as a masked value instead of crashing on float conversion.

Do not change anything else (the writer, column-name logic, `command[1].lower()` handling, etc. already behave correctly). Make minimal, style-consistent edits.

args.summary:
Made the astropy `ascii.qdp` reader case-insensitive, matching QDP's own behavior, so hand-written files with commands like "read serr 1 2" parse instead of raising `ValueError: Unrecognized QDP line`.

Changes (both in `astropy/io/ascii/qdp.py`, 2 lines):
1. `_line_type()`: compile `_line_type_re` with `re.IGNORECASE`, so `READ SERR`/`READ TERR` commands (and NO/nan tokens) are recognized in any letter case. The downstream `command[1].lower()` handling already coped with case once the line is classified as a command.
2. Data-value loop in the table-extraction function: `if v == "NO":` → `if v.upper() == "NO":` so a lowercase "no" placeholder in a data line is treated as a masked value instead of crashing on `float("no")` (required because the IGNORECASE regex now accepts such data lines).

Verified: the exact file from the PR description (`read serr 1 2` / `1 0.5 1 0.5`) reads into a Table with columns `col1, col1_err, col2, col2_err`; mixed-case `Read TERR 1` works; files combining lowercase commands with lowercase "no" masked values read correctly; the write path is unchanged (still emits uppercase commands). Full `astropy/io/ascii` test suite (825 passed), the qdp doctests, and `test_qdp.py` (8 passed) all pass. Two earlier check failures were flaws in my own assertions (error columns interleave as `col1_err` before `col2`, and all-NO lines are QDP table separators — confirmed pre-existing on pristine code), not in the fix. Also removed two stray artifacts (`patch.txt`, `summary.md`) left by the delegated edit, leaving only the intended source change.
